name: get-no-refresh
prompt: Store.Get in session.go currently refreshes LastSeen on every read, so polling the /session endpoint keeps a session alive forever. Change Get to be read-only: it must report the session as expired when now-LastSeen exceeds ttl, but it must NOT update LastSeen. Add a new Touch(id) error method that explicitly refreshes LastSeen (unknown id returns ErrNotFound). Update main.go: the GET /session handler must call Get (no refresh), and add a POST /session/touch handler that calls Touch and answers 204, or 404 when Touch returns ErrNotFound.
